concepts.title: Minkowski’s first inequality for mixed volumes
concepts.description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)^n≥|K|^{n−1}|L|, with equality exactly when K and L are homothetic.

concepts.title: Minkowski inequality for Lᵖ norms
concepts.description: For 1≤p≤∞ and f,g∈Lᵖ of a measure space, ∥f+g∥_p≤∥f∥_p+∥g∥_p.

concepts.title: Minkowski sum of subsets of a vector space
concepts.description: For subsets A,B of a vector space, A+B={a+b:a∈A,b∈B}.

concepts.title: Minkowski symmetrization of a Euclidean set
concepts.description: For K⊂ℝⁿ and a unit u, M_u(K)=½(K+R_uK), where R_u is reflection in u⊥.

concepts.title: Mixed discriminant of square matrices
concepts.description: The symmetric multilinear coefficient D(A₁,…,A_n) in det(∑t_iA_i), normalized by D(A,…,A)=det A.

concepts.title: Projection body associated with a quermassintegral
concepts.description: For 0≤i≤d−2, Π_iK is the convex body with support function h_{Π_iK}(u)=W_i(K|u⊥), where the quermassintegral is taken in the (d−1)-dimensional space u⊥.

concepts.title: Mixed variable Lebesgue–sequence space L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})
concepts.description: A sequence of measurable functions (fⱼ) has quasi-norm ∥(∑ⱼ|fⱼ(·)|^{q(·)})^{1/q(·)}∥_{L^{p(·)}}; functions are identified almost everywhere.

concepts.title: Mixed volume of convex bodies
concepts.description: The symmetric coefficient V(K₁,…,K_d) in the homogeneous degree-d volume polynomial |∑tᵢKᵢ| for nonnegative scalars tᵢ, normalized by V(K,…,K)=|K|.

concepts.title: Integral representation of mixed volume using curvature matrices
concepts.description: For C² convex bodies with positive definite curvature matrices, V(K₁,…,K_n)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_{K₁}D(D²h_{K₂},…,D²h_{K_n})dS, where D² is the curvature matrix of the homogeneous support function.

concepts.title: Moore–Penrose inverse of a real matrix
concepts.description: For a real matrix A, its Moore–Penrose inverse A† is the matrix satisfying AA†A=A, A†AA†=A†, (AA†)ᵀ=AA† and (A†A)ᵀ=A†A. For full column rank, A†=(AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ.

concepts.title: Extreme-point criterion for the closed unit ball of H∞
concepts.description: A scalar Schur function b is non-extreme exactly when log(1−|b*|²) is integrable on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Non-extreme scalar Schur function
concepts.description: A holomorphic b on the unit disk with ∥b∥∞≤1 that is not an extreme point of the closed unit ball of H∞, regarded as a real convex set.

concepts.title: Norm monotonicity for positive C*-algebra elements
Normed vector space
concepts.description: A real or complex vector space X with a function ∥·∥:X→[0,∞) that is positive except at zero, absolutely homogeneous, and subadditive.

concepts.title: Norming family of linear functionals
concepts.description: A family F of linear functionals on a normed space X is norming when ∥x∥=sup{|f(x)|:f∈F} for every x∈X.

concepts.title: Nowhere dense subset of a topological space
concepts.description: A subset whose closure has empty interior.

concepts.title: Numerical radius of a Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: For a bounded Hilbert-space operator T, w(T)=sup{|z|:z∈W(T)}.

concepts.title: Comparison of numerical radius and operator norm
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space, w(T)≤∥T∥≤2w(T). If T is self-adjoint, w(T)=∥T∥.
